title: The Invisible Institution Behind One Collection
author: RN Collins
principle: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

narrativeSequence.caption: A collection is never carried by visibility alone: it moves through a temporary institution of skilled people, decisions, files, permissions, deadlines, money, tools, and credits whose power should be made legible.
The sheet demonstrates a contract-shaped network of design, printing, manufacture, advertising, attribution, and distribution—even when the operative agreements are absent from the image.
narrativeSequence.rights: Free to Use and Reuse / Library of Congress curated set

narrativeSequence.caption: 01 · SEE — Who is actually in the institution?. Begin with people and entities, not an idealized org chart. Record each role, the work performed, employment or contracting status if verified, jurisdiction, decision authority, dependencies, and the evidence supporting the entry. Unknown must remain unknown.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 02 · HAND OFF — What crosses between them?. A sketch, toile, pattern, specification, fitting note, approval, image, sample, purchase order, credential, or verbal correction carries different kinds of knowledge. Bind every consequential handoff to a named sender, receiver, version, decision, deadline, and return path.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 03 · CREDIT — Whose labor becomes visible?. Public credit, legal authorship, ownership, compensation, and cultural recognition are different fields. Preserve the contributor’s preferred name and role while separately recording the governing contract or policy and any disputed or omitted attribution.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 04 · TEST POWER — Who can stop, change, approve, or leave?. Map vetoes, approvals, revision burdens, payment triggers, confidentiality, reuse, termination, safety escalation, archive access, and correction. A glamorous credit list without decision and remedy fields can still hide the institution.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 17 U.S.C. § 101 — Definitions is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.
narrativeSequence.rights: U.S. statutory text; quote narrowly and link.

narrativeSequence.caption: 17 U.S.C. § 201 — Ownership of copyright is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.
narrativeSequence.rights: U.S. statutory text; quote narrowly and link.

mapping.prompt: Choose one completed look and identify every verified contributor and entity from first research record through archive deposit.
For each handoff, attach the exact file, object, message, approval, or agreement that proves it.
Separate public credit, compensation, authorship, ownership, approval, and remedy into different fields.
Invite contributors to correct their names, roles, pronouns, scope, confidentiality, and missing labor before release.
